name: Shell Script Idempotency
description: A shell script whose recorded second-run behavior (idempotent no-op, or a described change) must match what actually happens when it is run twice.

fields.label: Environment setup
fields.help: Runs once before either invocation of the script — creates any files/state the script assumes already exist.

fields.label: Expected second-run result
fields.help: Describes whether re-running is a safe no-op or causes a further change.
